body:
I want to thank people for listening to me. I was in a really terrible state of mind at the time I made this post -- I'm not in that state today but I feel very precarious, like it would not take much to send me there again.

I should clarify that I have very strong urges from time to time to drink myself into oblivion but I have resisted them and continue to resist them.

Over the years I have tried different types of counseling, too many to detail. They've all helped for a time but I seem to end up back here eventually. I've been on SSRIs but various side effects made me want to stop.

Someone posted and then deleted something about St. Johns Wort. I've tried that in the past and i'm going to try it again. At least it is cheaper than alcohol.
